text.I think it is OK to pay for 2 music apps: Sa tingin ko, okay lang magbayad para sa 2 music app!

text.Maybe because there are many people in t: Siguro dahil maraming tao na nasa edad 30 hanggang 50, pakiramdam ko maraming kanta mula noong 2000s.
